subject: R1-P on ethan_cai refused until trackp fit (90be1d1)
body: tracks.json P -> ethan_cai is picked up. But ethan_cai has only seed_choices/seed_pairs, so R1-P would have run on an empty default profile and R1-P-prompt on no history: a no-taste run labelled R1-P. Both now exit and ask for trackp fit. Once usermodel.json + history.jsonl exist, R1-P works with no change on my side. Track S is still missing from tracks.json (marius_hobbhahn?).
